comment: Two figures in the manual do not match the code. Energy maps to 10ms to 20ms at src/modules/Clap.hh:66, not the 5ms to 15ms the manual gives; Color maps to 800Hz to 1600Hz at :133-134, not 800Hz to 16kHz, and the knob's own tooltip repeats the manual's 16kHz. The three spread times at :74-76 and the verb decay at :70 do match. The bandpass Q is fixed at 2 (:17). Saturation is a gain of 1 to 10 applied after the mix has already been multiplied by 5 (:113-115), so the output reaches the -5V to 5V clamp at :117 on most settings. Envelopes 2, 3 and 4 are armed by delayCounter equalling a sample count at :81-93, and the counter is reset by every trigger at :56.
